content.short: Safe CORE provides modular smart contract accounts from Safe.
content.description: Safe CORE sits at the forefront of a modular smart account infrastructure, unlocking a flexible foundation for developers to build a wide range of applications and wallets that run on modular smart accounts across Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, and Base. By advancing universal and open contract standards for the custody of digital assets, data, and identity, Safe CORE promotes true ownership of accounts for users and enables interoperable, secure management of assets, information, and access across apps and services.
